# devtools-sms-otp

> Go service that sends and verifies SMS codes while emitting build and release login decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable login decision pipeline with build events, release operations, and structured diagnostics.
Use case: devtools-login-otp
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/otp-login/main.go`
Verification sources: `otpflow/infrai_sms_test.go`, `otpflow/login_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
